title: Performance Marketing Agency in South Carolina
metaTitle: Performance Marketing in South Carolina | TDM
metaDescription: Google, Meta and TikTok ads for South Carolina businesses, planned around tourist seasons, border markets and real margins. Team member based in South Carolina.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) runs paid advertising for South Carolina businesses on Google, Meta and TikTok, managed against what the spend returns and not against clicks. In this state the two decisions that matter most are where your ads show and when. A Myrtle Beach attraction needs to reach families in other states months before summer. A Rock Hill dentist needs to avoid paying for clicks from the far side of Charlotte. We set targeting and budgets around those facts.

sections.heading: Why targeting is harder here than it looks
paragraphs: South Carolina's markets do not stop at the state line. Rock Hill and Fort Mill sit inside the Charlotte area. Aiken and North Augusta share a market with Augusta, Georgia. Hilton Head, Bluffton and Beaufort are closely tied to Savannah. A simple radius around your address can spend a good part of the budget on people who will never cross the river or the border to reach you, or it can miss customers who cross it every day.

The coast adds a second problem. Much of the money spent in Charleston, on the Grand Strand and on Hilton Head comes from visitors, and many of them drive in from neighbouring states and from further up the East Coast. Campaigns for hotels, rentals, golf and attractions therefore run in those home markets during the planning months, then switch to people physically in the area once the season starts.

sections.heading: Budgets that follow the South Carolina calendar
paragraphs: Demand moves through the year in ways that are specific to each region. Myrtle Beach peaks with summer family holidays, has golf seasons in spring and autumn, and sees winter visitors from the north, including Canadians, some of them French speakers we can advertise to in French. Charleston is busiest in spring and autumn, with weddings and festivals such as Spoleto. In Columbia and Clemson, autumn Saturdays are shaped by college football, which lifts restaurants, hotels and retail on home-game weekends.

Then there is hurricane season. When a storm threatens the coast, bookings stop and searches turn to closures and cancellations. Ads should be paused or reworded quickly, and restarted with the right message when the area reopens.

sections.heading: What the work includes
paragraphs: Campaigns run in ad accounts you own, with us added as a manager, so spend and change history are always visible to you. Before launch we check your margins and agree a target return or cost per lead.
bullets: Google Ads: Search, Shopping, Performance Max and YouTube.
Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram, from first contact to conversion.
TikTok ads using short video made by our own media team.
Retargeting for abandoned bookings, carts and enquiry forms.
Landing pages built and tested by our developers.
Conversion tracking checked end to end, including phone calls and form leads.
Monthly reports showing spend, revenue and return against the agreed target.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before you hire
paragraphs: Ask who owns the ad accounts and the data if you part ways. Ask how leads are tracked back to sales, especially phone calls, which carry much of the business for contractors, clinics and law firms. Ask how the agency handles locations near a state border. And ask what happens to your budget in your quiet months.

cards.heading: How South Carolina businesses use paid ads

items.title: Hotels, rentals and attractions
items.text: Reach travellers in their home state while they plan, then people already in Myrtle Beach, Charleston or Hilton Head looking for something to do today.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina. Campaign management, creative and reporting are handled by our wider team remotely, and you deal directly with the people running your account.

faqs.q: How much should a South Carolina business spend on Google Ads?
faqs.a: It depends on your margins, your area and how many competitors bid on the same searches. We work out a starting budget from your own numbers during a free consultation, and our management fee is quoted after that conversation.

faqs.q: Can you advertise to tourists before they arrive in Myrtle Beach or Charleston?
faqs.a: Yes. We target the states and cities your visitors come from during the months they plan and book, then run separate campaigns for people who are in the area.

faqs.q: How quickly will paid ads bring leads?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements, tracking and what is already in place. Ads can start gathering data soon after launch, but the timeline for setup and for reaching your targets is agreed in the plan.

faqs.q: Is Facebook or Google better for a local business in South Carolina?
faqs.a: Google usually suits services people need now, such as repairs, legal help or a clinic. Facebook and Instagram suit businesses people discover and choose visually, such as restaurants, rentals and retail.
